independence_evidence: Published from its own Barcelona address by a small team (about page lists publisher ABHFYA.com, Carrer del Mar 17, 08003 Barcelona); distributed via KD Presse. No link to any media group.
qualifies_reason: Independent Barcelona print title with issues 26 (June 2025), 27 (Nov/Dec 2025) and 28 (June 2026) on sale in its own shop.
what_it_is: A men's fashion and youth-culture magazine from Barcelona, each issue built around a single theme (recent ones: Dopamine, Dreamcore, Transparency). It runs long photographic fashion stories with young models and musicians, plus interviews with designers and creatives, across roughly 400 pages and several collectable covers per issue. It suits readers who follow menswear, emerging photographers and pop culture.
